{{Quote|Our twin planet, Gamandar, was totally subjugated. The Empire has built an enormous fortress there and completely enslaved the populace.|[[Primor (Inleshat)|Primor]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 74">[[Star Wars (1977) 74|''Star Wars'' (1977) 74]]</ref>}}
The '''Gamandar Citadel''' was a large fortress on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gamandar]] controlled by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Griggor Tower]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] built the structure following their [[Subjugation of Gamandar|subjugation]] of the [[Gamandar (species)|local populace]].
